details:
Q1
Which part of this repository is in scope for this request? Pick the main target.
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / implement workflow behavior
B. Review autofix / PR review loop
C. Orchestrator / poller / stall recovery
D. Docs / README / setup / templates
E. A specific file, workflow, or script path — please name it (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What concrete example should this change address?
Choices:
A. A specific issue, PR, or workflow run — I’ll provide the number or link (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file/path plus what is wrong there
C. No single example — I’ll describe the current behavior and the desired behavior in words
Q3
What should “better” mean here?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect behavior / a bug (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce flakiness, retries, or stuck runs
C. Improve performance, cost, or token/API usage
D. Improve docs, onboarding, or maintainability
E. Add missing automation or coverage
Q4
How broad should the change be?
Choices:
A. Small targeted change in one workflow/script/file (RECOMMENDED)
B. Medium change within one subsystem
C. Broad repo-wide improvement
